title: Width bound for a second-layer gate
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and choose any set of first-layer gates as inputs to a second-layer gate. The function computed by that gate has either a DNF representation or a CNF representation of width at most the width of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A depth circuit C on the n-dimensional sign cube
